say:2:1041307001:1.text: ♪ ...In this beautiful village, drink with me. In this quiet time, drink with me... ♪
say:2:1041307001:1.source_cn: 与我共饮吧，在这美丽的村落；与我共饮吧，为这宁静的时光……

say:3:1041307002:1.text: ♪ ...The boat swayed on the lake before I could wake. The waves cut through the moonlight like a blade. A lovely girl said she'll drink with me in Ivoryshade... ♪
say:3:1041307002:1.source_cn: 木船荡在湖上，水波剪开月光。那热情的姑娘，她说，与我共...

say:4:1041307003:1.text: The melody is wonderful, but the lyrics are incorrect.

say:5:1041307004:1.text: When we stayed in Ivoryshade, there was neither a boat ride nor was there any moonlight.
say:5:1041307004:1.source_cn: 我们在月影乡停留的那天晚上既没有坐船，也没有月亮。

say:6:1041307005:1.text: But there was a lovely girl! You don't understand. This is called artistic license.
say:6:1041307005:1.source_cn: 但是有热情的姑娘啊！你不明白，这叫做“艺术再加工”！
